label: synth_industrial_buyout_memo
draft:
We are writing to inform you of a new investment by Meridian Industrials Fund V in Helvetia Precision Components AG, a Zurich-headquartered manufacturer of high-precision machined components for the medical devices, aerospace, and semiconductor end markets.

The transaction values HPC at an enterprise value of EUR 1.15 billion, representing 11.2x trailing twelve months EBITDA of EUR 103 million. Fund V will invest EUR 480 million of equity for a 78 percent controlling stake, with the founding Schiller family and management retaining the balance.

HPC's competitive position is exceptional. The Company is one of three qualified suppliers globally for hip and knee replacement components meeting both FDA Class II and EU MDR requirements at scale, with switching costs for medical device customers measured in years rather than months. Revenue has grown from EUR 312 million in 2020 to EUR 587 million in 2024, a compound annual rate of 17 percent. EBITDA margins have expanded from 15.4 percent to 17.5 percent over the same period.

Our value creation plan rests on four pillars. International margin expansion through footprint consolidation in Switzerland and procurement programs is expected to deliver 300 to 400 basis points of EBITDA margin uplift. End-market growth in medical implants and aerospace builds, where HPC has structural exposure, supports 9 percent compound revenue growth over our planned five-year hold. M&A in the fragmented European precision machining sector, where we have identified five actionable targets, will accelerate scale. Operating leverage on the broader cost base will contribute the balance.

The base case generates 2.4x MOIC and 19 percent gross IRR. The principal risks — semiconductor cyclicality, customer concentration, foreign exchange, and founder transition — are understood and reflected in our planning. We have committed funding for two to three add-on acquisitions over the hold and have already identified the priority pipeline.
